name: Halftone Dossier
summary: A retro printed case file on cream archive paper: overprinted halftone dots in five flat inks, black slab headlines with a pink misregistered shadow, a navy caption pill, slamming rubber stamps and a thick-outlined kawaii suspect, read one exhibit at a time.
suits: social shorts that work without sound

palette.use: cream archive paper: the light-scene ground
navy, the one dark ink: outlines, headlines, caption pill, HUD, fade-out
night 2: the lighter dot layer on night scenes; quiet HUD lines
the paper's fold line and ruled lines (proposed)
pink: the misregistration and caption offset shadow, cheeks, the halftone over yellow
yellow: keywords, numerals, starbursts, the folder
the title card ground, halo dots, the suspect's body, one ink layer
stamps, alarms and the REC dot only
text on dark, bellies, eye highlights, specks
a pale flat fill under a halftone

type.case: sentence case headlines; uppercase stamps, HUD and title word
type.emphasis: the keyword in yellow in the caption pill; giant halftone numerals; a stamp

banned: gradients or transparency ramps: tone is dot size and overprint
fading text in: everything pops in with overshoot
line boil on text, dots, HUD or captions (characters and drawn props only)
more than five inks plus paper; a dot step under 14 px
a frame without dots, paper and (outside the title card) the HUD
risograph zine collage, Swiss grid type on white, candy game-show sets
glowing dark scenes: night is still printed (multiplied by paper)
copying a specific pop-art or comic reference
